|game_text=Deploy on table. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove those cards (except with Monnok). Once per turn, may take Logistical Delay, peek at a card placed face-down by You’re A Slave into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle?, or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. (Immune to Alter.)
|errata_history=Versions of [[Scrambled Transmission (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Scrambled Transmission (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 2, slip 18 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “Deploy on table. Opponent may not look at or remove cards from your hand while you hold < 13 cards. Once per turn, you may peek at any face down card just placed on table, ▲ Logistical Delay, or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. A” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•18” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Scrambled Transmission (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf], page 2, slip 18), after the Committee's errata of 10 June 2003, on the same old slip: “Deploy on table. Opponent may not look at or remove cards from your hand while you hold < 13 cards (except with Monnok). Once per turn, you may peek at any face down card just placed on table, ▲ Logistical Delay, or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. A” '''What changed:''' “cards.” became “cards (except with Monnok).”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 18), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove those cards (except with Monnok). Once per turn, may take Logistical Delay, peek at a card placed face-down by You’re A Slave into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle?, or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
